```lean
theorem lg_target (z : ZMod 4) : z * z ≠ 2 := by
  intro h
  cases z with n
  rw [ZMod.val_eq_coe, ZMod.val_eq_coe] at h
  have hnz : n < 4 := ZMod.val_pos n
  calc
    (n : ℤ) * n = 2 : by rw [h]
    ... = 2 % 4 : by rw [ZMod.coe_mul, ZMod.coe_val]
  simp only [mod_eq_iff_div_eq_floor_mul_add_rem, mul_mod_left, mod_self] at this
  exact absurd this (lt_irrefl 2)
```
